$comment: Every external https host that appears in lib/, app/ or mcp/. Keep it in step with the README section "Your data stays yours" (see CONTRIBUTING, Outbound connections). lib/outbound-hosts.test.ts fails on a host that is not listed here.

requests.accounts.google.com: Google sign-in (Auth.js Google provider, not a literal in our code)
requests.oauth2.googleapis.com: Google OAuth token refresh and revoke
requests.www.googleapis.com: Search Console and PageSpeed Insights APIs; also the OAuth scope names
requests.ssl.bing.com: Bing Webmaster Tools API, only with the user's own key
requests.api.dataforseo.com: DataForSEO API, only with the user's own key
requests.api.github.com: Daily update check (CRAWLSEO_UPDATE_CHECK=false turns it off)

notRequested.github.com: Link to a release page in the sidebar footer, opened by the user
notRequested.crawlseo.cloud: Info URL inside the crawler User-Agent string
